mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.2% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% signals persistent labor market slack, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts (HOUST > 700) and retail sales (RSAFS > 400000) growth indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 700 and RSAFS > 400000.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-crisis recovery regime, industrial production (INDPRO) above 95 signals expanding manufacturing output, supporting corporate profit growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in > 60% of instances during the post-crisis recovery regime.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL values between 220 and 230 indicate stable inflation, supporting sustained economic growth and positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL is between 220 and 230.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment (PAYEMS) exceeding 132,000 thousand persons signals labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 132000.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent industrial production (INDPRO > 95) and housing starts (HOUST > 700) growth indicates synchronized supply expansion, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 95 and HOUST > 700.

mechanism_narrative: During the consumer spending recovery regime, retail sales (RSAFS) above 400,000 million dollars indicates accelerating consumer expenditure, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances during the consumer spending recovery regime.
